title: SITUATEDQA: Incorporating Extra-Linguistic Contexts into QA

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating QA models on geographically dependent questions by comparing accuracy on common vs. rare locations, and analyzing the default geographical assumptions (e.g., assuming the context is the United States or India) when no location is explicitly provided in the prompt.

Measuring model accuracy on temporally dependent questions by comparing performance on stable facts versus recently updated facts, and testing the models' ability to differentiate between querying for current versus past answers.
